objectives.text: Restore local power in the utility generator room.
Find the surgical credential in the operating theatre.
Reach the surgical wing and survive decontamination.
Take the transfer lift to Containment.

architectural_direction.admissions: Reception desk canopy/service glazing, triage C3 portal/pillars, ceiling pipes, ordered bed bays; no blank box gallery.
architectural_direction.utilities: Visible pump/generator machinery, pipe bundles and exposed support ribs; maintenance height changes readable.
architectural_direction.clinical: Clinical observation glazing and service panels, surgical work islands/task lamps and lower ceiling zones.
architectural_direction.transfer: Containment ribs, machinery alcoves, decon warning portal and mounted landing fixtures.
